prescripto.name: Prescripto
prescripto.overview: A production-grade, tablet-optimized clinic management platform engineered for a real-world healthcare practice. Currently utilized by Gokul's brother for his active clinic.
prescripto.architecture: Configured with a React front-end interface, Supabase serverless database layer, PostgreSQL relational schema, and custom handwriting rendering engine with Apple Pencil pressure sensitivity.
prescripto.tech: React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
prescripto.features: Real-time clinic queue management, patient vitals tracking, prescription history, handwritten digital prescription canvas.
prescripto.challenges: Synchronizing real-time queue states dynamically across multiple devices while preventing appointment conflicts.
prescripto.results: Deployed live and currently active in-clinic. Slashed prescription processing time and improved patient record lookup speeds by 50%.
